create_bullet_robot_model: create a BulletRobotModel from a URDF file path with optional visualization enabled
get_bullet_backend: get the PyBullet backend from a BulletRobotModel for 3D collision checks
create_pybullet_ik_solver: create a PybulletIKSolver with a URDF path, end-effector link name, and controlled joints list
compute_forward_kinematics: compute forward kinematics for given joint positions and return end-effector position and quaternion
compute_inverse_kinematics: compute inverse kinematics for a desired position and orientation with optional initial joint configuration
